transcript.content: Hello. What brings you to the clinic today?

I'm here because I've been feeling persistently depressed, down, and sad for a very long time now. It has been going on continuously for about two years and five months, and I just can't seem to shake this low mood.

Have you ever had periods of time lasting at least a few days where you felt the opposite of depressed—like having unusually high energy, needing very little sleep, or feeling extremely happy or wired?

No, I've never experienced anything like that or felt wired with high energy. It has actually been the complete opposite for me, where I just feel constantly exhausted, low on energy, and really down.
During this period of nearly two and a half years, have you had any times where you felt like your normal self and were completely free of depression for more than two months?

I'm not really sure, to be honest. I haven't kept close track of it, so I don't know if there was ever a full two-month stretch where I felt completely normal. It just feels like this low mood has been there pretty much the whole time.
Along with your low energy, have you struggled with things like poor sleep, changes in your appetite, low self-esteem, or feelings of hopelessness?

Yes, my sleep is terrible—I have trouble falling asleep, wake up constantly, and always feel unrefreshed, and my appetite has changed quite a bit too. However, I don't really experience low self-esteem or feel hopeless. I just feel incredibly tired and worn out all the time.
Have you noticed a significant loss of interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy, like hobbies or spending time with friends and family?
I'm not really sure, to be honest. I don't think I've lost interest in the things I enjoy, I'm just usually too exhausted to actually do them.
Have you found it difficult to concentrate, focus on tasks, or make everyday decisions during this time?

I haven't noticed any significant trouble with making decisions or concentrating specifically. However, I do find that I get mentally exhausted very quickly whenever I try to think or focus deeply on anything.
Have you experienced any feelings of worthlessness, excessive or inappropriate guilt, or thoughts of death or suicide during this time?
No, I haven't had any feelings of worthlessness or guilt. I also haven't experienced any thoughts of death or suicide.
